Voice:

Line: 226

Voice:

File: TALK/RYOJI_TALK.NUT

Voice:

一定程度还能闪避，

context:
File: TALK/RYOJI_TALK.NUT
Line: 233
Speaker: IMC_KAJI
Voice:

多输几次也没关系
多尝试不同战术就好
context:
File: TALK/RYOJI_TALK.NUT
Line: 234
Speaker: IMC_KAJI
Voice:

original: まあ、惜しかったな
context:
File: TALK/RYOJI_TALK.NUT
Line: 235
Speaker: IMC_KAJI
Voice:

translation:
多输几次也没关系
多尝试不同战术就好
context:
File: TALK/RYOJI_TALK.NUT
Line: 236
Speaker: IMC_KAJI
Voice:

translation:

context:
File: TALK/RYOJI_TALK.NUT
Line: 237
Speaker: IMC_KAJI
Voice:

original: 結局、本部に突入されたか、\nダメージを受けすぎたかのどっちかだ▽
translation:

要么是损伤超过临界值▽
context:
File: TALK/RYOJI_TALK.NUT
Line: 238
Speaker: IMC_KAJI
Voice:

original: 防御を固めて攻撃をこちらにむければ、\n回避できるんじゃないか？
translation:
强化防御并诱导攻击方向的话，
应该能闪避成功吧？
context:
File: TALK/RYOJI_TALK.NUT
Line: 239
Speaker: IMC_KAJI
Voice:

original: 模擬戦で良かったよ　\nあんまり痛くないからな
translation:
幸好是模拟战
痛觉反馈调低了
context:
File: TALK/RYOJI_TALK.NUT

Voice:

context:

Line: 241
Speaker: IMC_KAJI
Voice:

哎，模拟战终究是模拟战
别太往心里去
context:
File: TALK/RYOJI_TALK.NUT
Line: 242
Speaker: IMC_KAJI
Voice:

original: ま　模擬戦は模擬戦だよ　\n今のうちに取り返せるかどうかが重要だな
